description: This file defines the CameraCaptureManager class responsible for managing camera operations on Android devices, including listing available camera devices, capturing photos with EXIF data, and recording short video clips. It handles permissions, camera device selection, image processing (rotation, scaling, encoding), and video recording, integrating with Android's CameraX library and Kotlin coroutines.

classes.name: CameraCaptureManager
classes.description: Manages camera operations such as listing devices, capturing images (snap), and recording video clips (clip). Handles permissions, device selection, image processing, and integrates with CameraX API for camera control.

classes.name: Payload
classes.description: Data class representing the JSON payload of a captured image.

classes.name: FilePayload
classes.description: Data class representing a recorded video file along with metadata such as duration and audio presence.

classes.name: CameraDeviceInfo
classes.description: Data class containing information about a camera device, including id, name, position, and device type.

methods.name: attachLifecycleOwner
methods.description: Associates a LifecycleOwner with this manager to manage camera lifecycle.

methods.name: attachPermissionRequester
methods.description: Associates a PermissionRequester for handling permission requests.

methods.name: listDevices
methods.description: Lists available camera devices, returning their info.

methods.name: ensureCameraPermission
methods.description: Checks and requests camera permission if not granted.

methods.name: ensureMicPermission
methods.description: Checks and requests microphone permission if not granted.

methods.name: snap
methods.description: Captures a photo based on provided JSON parameters, returning image data with EXIF info.

methods.name: clip
methods.description: Records a short video clip based on provided JSON parameters, returning file info and metadata.

methods.name: rotateBitmapByExif
methods.description: Rotates a Bitmap according to its EXIF orientation.

methods.name: parseFacing
methods.description: Parses camera facing direction from params JSON.

methods.name: parseQuality
methods.description: Parses image quality setting from params JSON.

methods.name: parseMaxWidth
methods.description: Parses maximum width for scaling from params JSON.

methods.name: parseDurationMs
methods.description: Parses duration in milliseconds for video recording from params JSON.

methods.name: parseDeviceId
methods.description: Parses device ID from params JSON.

methods.name: parseIncludeAudio
methods.description: Parses whether to include audio in video clip from params JSON.

methods.name: resolveCameraSelector
methods.description: Resolves the camera selector based on device ID and facing direction.

methods.name: cameraDeviceInfoOrNull
methods.description: Extracts device info from CameraInfo objects.

methods.name: cameraIdOrNull
methods.description: Retrieves camera ID string from CameraInfo.

methods.name: cameraProvider
methods.description: Suspends until the camera provider instance is available.

methods.name: takeJpegWithExif
methods.description: Captures a JPEG image and returns its bytes along with EXIF orientation info.
